body:
The input document a ticket mutation takes was discoverable only by reading an existing ticket out of the store, so every author re-derived the same field set — and re-derived it wrong, because `id` looks required and is not.

Build:
1. Resolve `--help` against the COMMAND before any store access, so `create --help` documents the input document and works in a repo with no store yet. Add `adlc ticket schema`.
2. One field table (lib/help.mjs) that the CLI help and the published schemas/ticket.schema.json are both generated from, with a drift gate.
3. Close what that surfaced: bind edit's expected hash before the editor runs; require --expect to write an update; gate lifecycle changes; one shared lock-owner predicate across acquire/read/release; make acquisition failure-atomic.
4. Cross-package: recognize generated ULIDs as local tickets in ticket-sync push, and stop pull erasing local-only fields such as `completed`.

Acceptance criteria:
1. `adlc ticket <command> --help` resolves for every advertised command through the public dispatcher. Verify: node --test scripts/test/ticket-help-contract.test.mjs
2. The committed schema is byte-equal to the generated one and never rejects a ticket validateTicket accepts. Verify: node --test packages/tickets/test/help.test.mjs
3. Every runtime export compiles for a TypeScript consumer. Verify: node --test scripts/test/type-declarations.test.mjs
4. A converged pull preserves `completed`. Verify: node --test packages/ticket-sync/test/roundtrip.test.mjs
5. Suite green. Verify: npm test
title: Make `adlc ticket` self-describing, and close what that surfaced
